messages:
Alex: Heads up—I'm flying into LHR next Tues and will be in Shoreditch around lunch. Anyone have quick gluten-free spots nearby? Prefer under 30 min service.
Maya: @Alex try Dishoom (they do gf naan-ish alternatives?) — but can be slow at lunch.
Dan: For fast gf, I actually like The Detox Kitchen on Newburgh St. Salads/bowls, always quick.
Sofia: @Dan that's Soho... Shoreditch I'd recommend Patchwork on Columbia Rd? Wait that's more brunchy.
John: Shoreditch, quick + gf = Salvation Jane? Their menu rotates but had gf wraps last month.
Emma: Also check out Bone Daddies — ramen's not gf but they have rice noodle options, and service is speedy.
Maya: FoodieBot, any quick recs near Shoreditch High St?
FoodieBot: Here's a shortlist: 1) BeyondBread — gluten-free bakery, sandwiches; 2) Grain&Co — bowls (30 min avg); 3) RamenOkay — rice noodles, quick takeaway. Map: https://maps.app/shoreditch-gf-options
Alex: Perfect, will try Grain&Co then. Anyone have tip for getting from LHR to Shoreditch quickly with lunch timing?
Dan: Take the Heathrow Express to Paddington then Elizabeth line to Liverpool St — ~35–45 min.
Sofia: Or Piccadilly + Hammersmith & City — cheaper but slower.
Alex: Thanks all! I'll DM for any meetup — maybe lunch 12:30 @Grain&Co. :thumbsup:
